name: inline-citation
title: Inline Citation
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Numeric marker that reveals a source title, domain, and excerpt on hover or focus.

meta.descriptionEs: Marcador numérico que, al pasar el cursor o enfocar, muestra título, dominio y extracto de la fuente.

examples.title: Cita en línea
examples.description: Marcador numérico que, al pasar el cursor o enfocar, muestra título, dominio y extracto de la fuente.

meta.usage: <InlineCitation index={1} source={{ title, domain, excerpt, href }} />

api.name: source
api.description: title, domain, excerpt, and optional href.

api.name: className / cardClassName
api.description: Classes for the marker and the card.

docs: Links are limited to http, https, and mailto. Keyboard focus opens the card and Escape closes it. No theme is shipped.
